positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer on the Observability team

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
I wore many hats while working for the Observability team responsible for maintaining visibility of Ford Motor Company's vehicle cloud platform. My time was spent configuring/maintaining tracing/metricing/logging infra, developing Springboot microservices, debugging complex distributed system problems using the tools we provided, and communicating and instrumenting best observability practices with engineering teams.
As my last achievement, I adopted leadership of building a data lake house responsible for providing key business insights for overall platform performance as experienced by the customer.
